⚠️ Important Notice
Some games use extremely strong anti-cheat systems that can detect and ban users running external modifications. To protect you, I’ve built in a safety blacklist: if you join a game known to issue bans during testing, the script will automatically kick you before anything loads.

Use at your own risk, and always stay aware of the game’s anti-cheat sensitivity.

Most Features in the script are Mobile Friendly Except for Recoil Control and Triggerbot
